name: Viktorias Home
beschreibung: Viktorias Home is situated in the heart of Kufstein, just a few minutes' walk from the iconic Kufstein Fortress and the pedestrian shopping area. The guesthouse features cozily furnished rooms boasting views of the town or the surrounding mountains. Guests particularly appreciate the quiet location within a historic building, while boutiques, restaurants, and cafés remain just a short stroll away. A light breakfast is included in the room rate.
